title: Enhancing Prediction of Myocardial Recovery After Coronary Revascularization: Integrating Radiomics from Myocardial Contrast Echocardiography with Machine Learning.
summary: Prospective MCE radiomics in 55 revascularization patients predicted recovery in 273 dysfunctional myocardial segments; radiomics/ML were compared with MBF (AUC 0.770), and recovery was defined by follow-up wall-motion improvement. Small patient cohort. AI role: Radiomics features with machine-learning prediction models. The article appeared in International Journal Of General Medicine.
